metadata.title: Operational Resilience (Secure‑Resilience Aligned)

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for surviving disruption while preventing unsafe recovery, unauthorized resumption, or concealment of harm.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Resilience, recovery, continuity, degradation, halt, isolation, recall handling, and resumption gating across all domains.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern assembling Secure‑Resilience semantics and solution patterns into a coherent operational resilience architecture.

props.name: resilience-model
props.remarks: Operational resilience prioritizes safe outcomes over availability, speed of recovery, or service continuity.

metadata.remarks: Operational Resilience composes foundational resilience semantics with recovery and continuity solution patterns. It defines when backup, recovery, disaster recovery, ransomware response, and continuity actions are permitted, degraded, suppressed, or forbidden.

components.title: Secure‑Resilience Core
components.description: Defines resilience eligibility, non‑equivalence, and permitted recovery outcomes.

components.title: Reversible vs Irreversible State
components.description: Classifies whether state may be safely restored or replayed.

components.title: Safe‑Halt vs Restore
components.description: Determines when halting execution is safer than restoration.

components.title: Degradation vs Continuity
components.description: Determines when reduced operation is safer than full continuity.

components.title: Recall‑Driven Recovery
components.description: Enforces authority‑driven suppression of restore and resume.

components.title: Resume Eligibility
components.description: Defines explicit criteria and authorization for resuming operation.

components.title: Backup and Recovery
components.description: Provides backup and restore capability subject to Secure‑Resilience eligibility.

components.title: Disaster Recovery
components.description: Provides alternate processing and failover subject to Secure‑Resilience gating.

components.title: Ransomware Resilience
components.description: Provides ransomware containment and recovery actions subject to Secure‑Resilience eligibility.

components.title: Continuity of Operations
components.description: Provides degraded or limited continuity subject to Secure‑Resilience constraints.
